description: Release only one checksummed, pinned Git artifact to AccessProof production. No arbitrary command parameter.

runCommand: test "$SELF" = "i-0c11427d4d9c1b438" || { echo "Wrong production instance; refusing" >&2; exit 2; }

test -n "${SSM_releaseId:-}" && test -n "${SSM_commitSha:-}" && test -n "${SSM_archiveSha256:-}" && test -n "${SSM_expectedDbRevision:-}" && test -n "${SSM_artifactUrlB64:-}" || { echo "SSM agent does not support ENV_VAR interpolation; refusing" >&2; exit 2; }
test ! -e "$REL" || { echo "Release ID already used" >&2; exit 2; }

python3 - "$ZIP_URL" <<'PYURL'
import re, sys
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
u = urlparse(sys.argv[1]); q = parse_qs(u.query)
assert u.scheme == 'https' and u.hostname == 'accessproof-release-artifacts-102076848988-eu-north-1.s3.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com', 'Invalid artifact host'
assert not u.username and not u.password and not u.fragment and not u.port
assert re.fullmatch(r'/releases/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{5,80}-[0-9a-f]{12}\.tar', u.path), 'Invalid object path'
assert q.get('X-Amz-Algorithm') == ['AWS4-HMAC-SHA256'], 'Missing SigV4'
assert q.get('X-Amz-Signature') and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', q['X-Amz-Signature'][0]), 'Missing signature'
assert q.get('X-Amz-Expires') and int(q['X-Amz-Expires'][0]) <= 900, 'Excessive URL TTL'
PYURL
test "$(tar -xOf "$REL/artifact.tar" RELEASE_COMMIT)" = "$SSM_commitSha" || { echo 'Git commit mismatch' >&2; exit 2; }
